entries.headline: Fix: calculator scope flags + Milpitas conditional removal + homepage school-count caption
entries.detail: All Batch 19-28 items had descriptive applies_to values (e.g. 'detached ADU') that the fee calculator treats as unsupported, so every new fee page rendered 'Verification in progress' despite verified items on file. All 164 items now carry applies_to 'all' (the calculator's ADU scenario), with the original scope text preserved in notes where it added information. Milpitas's conditional $703 sprinkler review removed (total 165 -> 164 items). Homepage caption 'of 38 jurisdictions' replaced with the computed school-fee jurisdiction count (84).

entries.headline: Batch 28: 5 new jurisdictions, 11 verified fee items
entries.detail: Claremont, Glendora, Moorpark, San Rafael, Vallejo. Vallejo contributes 5 items; Claremont, Glendora and Moorpark enter with a single planning-side line each (zoning clearance / no-ADU-planning-fee confirmations); San Rafael adds 3.

entries.headline: Batch 27: 5 new jurisdictions, 10 verified fee items
entries.detail: Clovis, Covina, Diamond Bar, Folsom, Redondo Beach (HCD ADU-permit ranks #150-154). Folsom's FCUSD Level II school fee, $10.26/sq ft ($8,208 on 800 sq ft), is the matrix's second-highest school rate; Redondo Beach's named ADR-Minor ADU/JADU planning line is $1,970. Clovis (Level II inference) and Diamond Bar (vintage/partial lines) enter with no verified items yet - 12/1 re-verification.

entries.headline: Batch 26: 5 new jurisdictions, 29 verified fee items
entries.detail: Beverly Hills, Burlingame, Chico, Pacific Grove, Watsonville. Beverly Hills enters with 11 items: valuation-based surcharges only (General Plan maintenance, CBSC, contractor business tax) - its permit-fee-percentage surcharges (plan check 80% of permit fee, etc.) are verified in the research file but held back because the calculator has no percent-of-permit-fee method. Burlingame 6, Chico 5, Watsonville 5, Pacific Grove 2.

entries.headline: Batch 25: 5 new jurisdictions, 17 verified fee items
entries.detail: Bellflower, Newport Beach, Redlands, San Leandro, Walnut. Redlands is the batch's deepest row with 11 items; Bellflower's permit-fee-percentage surcharges (12% + 4% of permit fee) are verified but held back as unrepresentable in the calculator.

entries.headline: Batch 24: 5 new jurisdictions, 6 verified fee items
entries.detail: Buena Park, Paramount, South Pasadena, Vacaville, Yucaipa. The thinnest batch so far: South Pasadena and Vacaville enter with no verified items yet (all lines PARTIAL or vintage - 12/1 re-verification); Buena Park's single item is the OC San ADU capacity charge.

entries.headline: Batch 23: 5 new jurisdictions, 12 verified fee items
entries.detail: Fresno, Grover Beach, Inglewood, Milpitas, Monterey County (unincorporated). Monterey County's school line is the Salinas-area SUHSD Level II shared rate, $4.82/sq ft - Salinas pockets only, not countywide; North County differs. Correction (2026-10-21): Milpitas's $703 fire-sprinkler review fee was removed from the count - it is conditional on sprinklers being required, not part of the standard spec.

entries.detail: Concord, Hillsborough, Napa, South Gate, Stanislaus County (unincorporated) (HCD ADU-permit ranks #115-119). Stanislaus County's $3,061 flat PFF cap for ADUs and $2,625 flat ADU permit are the batch's headline figures; South Gate's $0 ADU connection exemption is codified.

entries.headline: Batch 19: 5 new jurisdictions, 26 verified fee items
entries.detail: Gardena, Moreno Valley, Orange County (unincorporated), San Mateo County (unincorporated), Santa Clara (city) (HCD ADU-permit ranks #110-114). entries.headline: Batch 5 late addition: Rosemead, 1 verified fee item
entries.detail: Rosemead's Batch 5 research was not in the 2026-10-19 deep-dive backfill, so its single confirmed dollar item - the $111 ADU covenant fee (FY 2025-26 fee schedule) - lands now. School, DIF, permit and connection lines remain PARTIAL or not found - 12/1 re-verification.

entries.headline: Deep-dive backfill: 21 jurisdictions, 75 verified fee items
entries.detail: Backfilled the 21 deep-dive cities whose posts were published but missing from the /compare/ calculator: Alhambra, Campbell, Chula Vista, Downey, Fontana, Fremont, Laguna Beach, Lakewood, Lancaster, Oceanside, Ontario, Oxnard, Pasadena, Salinas, San Bernardino, Santa Ana, Santa Barbara, Santa Monica, Santa Rosa, West Covina, Westminster. CONFIRMED-only: computed examples, ranges, proportional-to-primary figures, and unverifiable items excluded (notably the Oceanside blanket ADU impact exemption, which conflicts with the city's Aug 2025 park DIF nexus draft and needs post-level review). Every item carries a verified official source URL.

entries.headline: Batch 18: 5 new jurisdictions, 12 verified fee items
entries.detail: Hemet, Sunnyvale, Marin County, Jurupa Valley, San Fernando (HCD ADU-permit ranks #105–109). Hemet's $8.647/SF DIF ($6,918 on 800 sq ft) is the matrix's steepest 750-sq-ft cliff; Jurupa Valley runs its own DIF program (Ch. 3.75); Marin County shows special-district fragmentation. Proportional-to-primary fees (Jurupa DIF/MSHCP) and track-ambiguous permit tiers held back as PARTIAL.

entries.headline: Batch 17: 5 new jurisdictions, 9 verified fee items
entries.detail: Pico Rivera, Saratoga, Mountain View, El Cajon, El Dorado County (HCD ADU-permit ranks #100–104). First East County San Diego and El Dorado County coverage; Mountain View's two-district school split ($5.24/sq ft) is the matrix's first; El Dorado County's $1,320 fire fee drops ~94% under SB 1117. Derived/proportional figures (Saratoga elementary $3.72, per-DFU sewer) held back as PARTIAL.

entries.headline: Batch 16: 5 new jurisdictions, 5 verified fee items
entries.detail: Davis, Temple City, Palmdale, Redwood City, Bakersfield (HCD ADU-permit ranks #95–99). First Yolo County coverage; Redwood City's $1.78/sq ft ADU sewer line is explicit in ordinance; Bakersfield's stacked 2016-dated DIFs held back as PARTIAL. Also merged the duplicate Santa Clara County entry.
Tracy, Hayward, Coachella, Rancho Cucamonga, Richmond (HCD ADU-permit ranks #89–94). Hayward's $5,295 sewer line is the matrix's first explicit 'all ADUs pay utilities' case.
